qa.recommendation: Review whether unit 8 should be operating instead of cancelled.
qa.note: GEM shows unit 8 as cancelled with 56 MW. The VEO website timeline says Block 8 was commissioned in 2023. The Bundesnetzagentur list dated 26 June 2026 shows IKW Block 8 of ArcelorMittal Eisenhüttenstadt GmbH in operation, 89.7 MW gross, gas turbine with steam turbine, with a listed start year of 1954 that looks wrong. A May 2019 article in a regional newspaper announced the 45 million euro build with completion planned for 2021. I did not propose a status change because this batch only asked for a cancellation year.

qa.note: GEM shows ArcelorMittal Eisenhüttenstadt GmbH at 100 percent. The register lists ArcelorMittal Eisenhüttenstadt GmbH as operator.
